name: application-rating-summary-header
title: Rating Summary Header
description: Product/review header showing a large average score, a 5-star row with a proportionally clipped partial star for decimal averages, and a total-review count.
useWhen: A product or listing page needs a prominent, at-a-glance rating summary at the top of its reviews section.
The average is a decimal value (like 4.6) that benefits from an accurately fractional-filled star, not just rounding.
You want the total review count visible for credibility alongside the score.
avoidWhen: You need the full distribution across each star level (5-star: 60%, 4-star: 25%, etc.) — use rating-distribution instead, which this component is intentionally distinct from.
There are no reviews yet — show an explicit 'No reviews yet' state rather than a zero-filled star row.
The rating isn't on a 5-star scale — adapt the star count or swap for a numeric-only display.
responsiveBehavior: The header is an inline-sized flex row that wraps naturally at narrow widths, keeping the big number and star block together.
accessibility: The star row uses role="img" with an aria-label stating the precise decimal rating in words, since partial star fills convey nothing to screen readers.
The partial star is built from two overlaid, clip-pathed icons rather than a font trick, keeping the fill percentage visually accurate.
The total review count is always visible text, giving the average context rather than presenting it as an isolated number.

variants.title: Rating summary header
variants.description: 4.6 average with 4 full stars, one 60%-filled partial star, and a 'Based on 1,842 reviews' caption.
accessibility: The visible '4.6' number and the aria-label both carry the same precise value, avoiding any rounding mismatch.

variants.title: Rating summary header (Dark)
variants.description: Rating summary header adapted for dark application surfaces.
accessibility: Empty-star and caption colors must meet WCAG AA contrast on dark surfaces.
